info.cls_ename: Department of Mechanical and Computer-Aided Engineering

description.describe_ch: 經由實驗驗證熱力學、流體力學及熱傳學等等力學的重要理論。包含理想氣體方程式、熱力學定律、傳導、對流與輻射等現象之驗證。課程將透過實驗講解與分組實驗的方式來學習量測技術與理論驗證。
description.describe_eh: Use experiments to prove important theories of thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, and heat transfer. It includes verification of ideal gas equations, laws of thermodynamics, conduction, convection, and radiation. The course will learn measurement techniques and theoretical verification through experimental explanations and group experiments.
description.pre_subname: MCAE3000熱傳學、ENGS2005流體力學、MCAE2002熱力學(二)
description.pre_sub_ename: MCAE3000 HEAT TRANSFER、ENGS2005 FLUID MECHANICS、MCAE2002 THERMODYNAMICS(2)
